demo.title: hashlock-otc.sh
demo.code:
# Sell a block of your agent token to another agent at a negotiated price — no pool slippage
> post a Hashlock RFQ: sell 2,000,000 MYTOKEN on Base for USDC, and take the best quote above 40,000 USDC

# Answer someone else's RFQ as a maker
> quote the open Hashlock RFQs for MYTOKEN at 2% under the pool price

# Settle: fund, then claim — both sides paid or both refunded
> settle my Hashlock swap

setup: Use a Bankr API key with the Wallet API enabled and read-only off
Turn on "Enable arbitrary contract calls" in the Bankr wallet (HTLC escrow transactions are contract calls)
Keep ETH for gas on Base / Robinhood Chain
Run Hashlock's MCP server with your Bankr key (HASHLOCK_BANKR_API_KEY): it signs in and settles through your Bankr wallet — no sign-up
